facts.text: Drop Dead Ned, a greasy-haired thief at the Clumsy Fox, offers himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, willing to do anything as long as he gets to kill people with the wasp. He offers a 5-gold rebate per kill if he can do what he wants with the victims. Dr. Uriah said he'd think about it; accepting requires paying the fee.
